import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    ret = []
    at = False
    n = len(s)
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        if i <= n - 2 and s[i:i+2] == "at" and not at and i != 0 and i != n - 2:
            ret.append('@')
            at = True
            i += 2
        elif i <= n - 3 and s[i:i+3] == "dot" and i != 0 and i != n - 3:
            ret.append('.')
            i += 3
        else:
            ret.append(s[i])
            i += 1
    print(''.join(ret))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
